build_trainer_for_xlm: build a Trainer instance to train multilingual XLM models with CLM and MLM objectives
run_mt_step: run a machine translation training step with source and target language pairs using EncDecTrainer
run_bt_step: run a back-translation training step to generate synthetic parallel data for MT training
create_single_trainer: create a SingleTrainer to train a single encoder-only model with masked language modeling
create_encdec_trainer: create an EncDecTrainer to train encoder-decoder models for machine translation tasks
